supportedScope.files: Regular writable files with inherited ACLs; NTFS alternate streams, special file attributes, symlinks, hard links, submodules and Git mode changes are rejected.
supportedScope.base: Exact recorded commit; clean destination and unchanged semantic index.
supportedScope.validation: Only explicitly authorized executables and arguments; commands run as the current user in a separate Git copy.
supportedScope.recovery: Unknown later edits or metadata conflicts block rollback and preserve the transaction for inspection.
supportedScope.worktrees: New comparisons use .singularity-worktrees beside the project with inherited project permissions. Existing private worktrees remain recognized.
